summary: URLSession-style HTTP(S) with redirects, download and a memory cache exists, and GCD and ProcessInfo have SDK counterparts. Bonjour, XPC, streams/sockets/ports and Process/NSTask have no app-facing API.

features.feature: URL Loading: sessions, requests, data and download tasks
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/url.rs; docs/bifrost-ui.md (URLSession section); springboard/sdk/src/url_background.rs (URLSessionConfiguration, ConfiguredSession, BackgroundSession, URLSessionTaskMetrics); springboard/sdk/tests/url_session.rs
features.note: shared session, data_task, download_task with progress, streaming bytes, redirects up to 5; default/ephemeral/background configurations, task delegate challenges, task metrics, persisted background download queue. No upload tasks or OS-level background transfer. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLCache); wired: springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/feed_cache.rs (plan, stored_from, max_age_of, validators_of, Conditional); springboard/sdk/src/url_cache.rs (disk URLCache, CachedURLResponse, CachePolicy)
features.note: memory cache plus a disk URLCache with memory/disk capacity, Cache-Control/ETag/304 revalidation, oldest-first eviction and per-request CachePolicy, wired into ConfiguredSession. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: cookies, credentials, authentication challenges
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/http_auth.rs; springboard/sdk/src/http_cookies.rs; springboard/sdk/src/url_background.rs (ConfiguredSession wires jar, credential storage and delegate)
features.note: cookie jar (accept policy Always/Never) and credential storage are used by ConfiguredSession; a 401 Basic challenge goes to the delegate and is retried once. Digest, client-certificate and server-trust challenges, and AcceptPolicy.onlyFromMainDocumentDomain are not done. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: WebSocket and streaming tasks
features.note: ws:// client task: send/receive text and binary, sendPing, cancel(with:reason:), auto-pong; plain TCP stream task with line and data reads. No wss:// or StartSecureConnection. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: custom protocols and proxies, URL components
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. transport is swappable internally for tests only

publish/stop state, TXT records and a browser with didFind/didRemove delegate; the multicast transport feeds service_appeared/service_disappeared. No mDNS responder wired for advertise; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (JSON-RPC over owner-only Unix socket); docs/app-isolation.md
features.note: control socket serves RPC to an app with SO_PEERCRED check; no general app-to-service connection API or XPC services

features.feature: Object Runtime: exceptions, invocation, KVO, proxies
features.note: Objective-C runtime concepts; Rust has no counterpart. Observation covered by observable.rs

features.feature: Processes and Threads: queues and concurrency
features.note: GCD-style DispatchQueue, group, work item, QoS and a main queue; no OperationQueue or RunLoop

features.feature: Processes and Threads: process information and activity
features.note: memory, cores, uptime, thermal state, low power mode, beginActivity, sudden termination

features.feature: Processes and Threads: launching child processes
features.note: shell launches sandboxed apps under bubblewrap and cgroups; apps get no Process/Pipe wrapper (Rust std::process is available)

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. std::net and std::io are usable directly; no stream or port abstractions with run-loop scheduling

gaps: Bonjour mDNS responder (advertise on the wire)
wss:// WebSocket and StartSecureConnection on stream tasks
Digest, client-certificate and server-trust authentication challenges
